statement.zh: **标准**：密码模块测试要求（Test requirements for cryptographic modules）。
statement.en: **Standard**: Test requirements for cryptographic modules (密码模块测试要求).The attestable first-hand fact is the relationship printed in FIPS 140-3: "The testing for these requirements will be in accordance with ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)" - the same sentence then allows a validation authority to modify, add to or delete vendor evidence and testing.

statement.zh: 为什么需要独立的测试文件：FIPS 140-3 的关键词行把两套文件并列印出「Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS); ISO/IEC 19790; ISO/IEC 24759.」，而正文（§3）对测试执行者的规定是分离的：「accredited laboratories perform cryptographic module compliance/conformance testing.」（留存件里该短语紧跟在 NVLAP 括注之后）要求文件与被认可的检测程序分开，才能让同一套模块要求在实验室体系里被一致执行。
statement.en: Why a separate testing document: the keyword line of FIPS 140-3 prints the two ISO companions side by side, "Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS); ISO/IEC 19790; ISO/IEC 24759." and the body separates the requirement text from who performs testing: "accredited laboratories perform cryptographic module compliance/conformance testing." (in the retained file this phrase follows the NVLAP parenthetical) Splitting requirements from accredited test procedure is what lets one set of module requirements be applied consistently across laboratories.

statement.zh: 用法体现在验证链条上（§1 与 §12 的目录项）：模块按本国要求验证时，测试路径由这一份文件给出，而 FIPS 140-3 明确允许验证机构在其附录上作本国化的修改；同节还解释修改何以有限度——它先是声明与 ISO/IEC 19790:2012(E) 对齐并附以「includes modifications of the Annexes」，再在目录里列出「Documents Modifying ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)」一节，说明修正案是逐份登记、可核对的。
statement.en: Use sits in the validation chain, stated in §1 and listed in §12: modules are assessed against the national requirements while the testing path comes from this document, and FIPS 140-3 expressly permits annex modifications by the validation authority - it says it "includes modifications of the Annexes" and its contents list carries a section titled "Documents Modifying ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)".The point is that amendments are registered one by one and are therefore checkable rather than implicit.

statement.zh: 密码模块测试要求的broken见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: The first limit is evidentiary: the ISO/IEC 24759 text is not retained in this workspace, so this entry rests on FIPS 140-3's account alone and asserts nothing about clause numbers, test items or verdict rules.The second is a version discrepancy: the retained text names "ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)" while the catalog row's citation title reads ISO/IEC 24759:2025.

statement.zh:
沿革事实由留存件的日期与并列关系给出：FIPS 140-3 的日期行印作「Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 140-3 March 22, 2019」，其对齐的国际版是 19790:2012(E)、测试配套点名 24759:2017(E)——即国际标准先行、本国第三版对齐并在附录上留本国修改余地。获取链接与 DOI 行按项目口径留在引号之外，不进入正文。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：密码模块测试要求的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: The lineage comes from the retained dates and pairings: FIPS 140-3 prints "Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 140-3 March 22, 2019", aligns with ISO/IEC 19790:2012(E) and names ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E) for testing - the international editions came first, and the national third edition aligned to them while reserving annex modifications.Retrieval and DOI lines stay outside the quotes per house rule and never enter the article text.
